purpose: Track independent evidence and acceptance, not a reverse-engineering or parity percentage.

xboks.source_commit: dirty working tree; record Git revision plus local diff for each new run

evidence_rules: Package indexing does not establish semantic decompilation or every runtime path.
Static declarations, strings and file presence are not live service contracts.
Screenshots establish visible state only; original Windows click outcomes are unverified unless a run record is added.
A Linux unit test or demo fixture is not proof of real account, game, console, OS overlay or pixel parity.
The earlier source/document audit is retained; separately dated implementation verification records only the tests and fixture runs actually executed.
Use exact build, locale, viewport, profile, input mode and state for every visual acceptance run.
No global completion percentage is derived from this matrix.

levels.original_index: available bounds-checked package/bytecode index; feature semantics still separate
levels.original_static: partial evidence with explicitly stated inference
levels.screenshot_observation: observed named surface or missing complete reference
levels.original_windows_dynamic: recorded real original app action/result; currently absent
levels.linux_implementation: actual source exists, full function acceptance separate
levels.linux_verification: named current tests and scoped dated run reports; not inferred from presence
levels.overall_gate: open until per-feature acceptance is demonstrated
